'''Imbued tephra''' is obtained by imbuing [[refined tephra]] at the [[Altar (Zalcano)|Seren altar]] in the western end of [[Zalcano]]'s prison. It can also be obtained from [[golem (Zalcano)|golem]]s that Zalcano occasionally summons.

The imbued tephra is the only item that can deal damage to Zalcano while she is still standing; the damage dealt is scaled based on the player's [[Smithing]] and [[Runecraft]] levels. In addition, if she has summoned [[demonic symbol]]s around the prison, the blue symbols will increase the damage dealt. Players can either attack Zalcano directly while having the imbued tephra in their inventory to use them, or equip and throw them at her.
